package.name: aico2_rt_control
package.description:
Real-time (1 kHz) joint control for the AICO2 Rizon4 arms via the Flexiv RDK C++ API. Separate from aico2_left_arm_driver on purpose: that driver is Python and NRT, it works, and nothing here changes it.
Status: UNBUILT AND UNTESTED. Needs the RDK C++ library, which is a different artifact from the flexivrdk Python wheel. See README.md.
